**Skill nexusweb3-safety v1.1.0 — Major update: Now a read-only API reference for NexusWeb3 safety protocols.**

- Converted skill to a read-only API reference for protocols 21–30 on Base mainnet.
- Skill now focuses on contract addresses, function signatures, and usage examples for reading on-chain state — no operator key needed.
- All instructions for write operations (transactions) have been delegated to the separate `nexusweb3` skill.
- Description, usage, and quick start sections updated to clarify the read-only and reference nature of the skill.
- README.md added with updated content reflecting the API reference purpose.

Initial release of nexusweb3-safety — on-chain safety and compliance infrastructure for AI agents on Base mainnet.

- Introduces kill switch, KYA verification, tamper-proof audit logs, bounties, IP licensing, milestone payments, subscriptions, insolvency tools, referrals, and collective management features.
- Provides concrete contract addresses and code examples for key protocols (KillSwitch, KYA, AuditLog, Bounty, License).
- Includes network configuration for Base mainnet and guides agents on ETH/USDC requirements for operations.
- Documents protocol fees, usage workflows, and parameter details for secure agent integration.
